SELECT t2.nickname save_by_name, t3.chinese_name microbe_name, t3.latin_name, t4.name tube_name, t1.id, t1.code, t1.expiration_date, t1.save_date, t1.status, t1.create_time, t1.remark, t1.thaw_freeze_cycle_count, t5.id stock_id, t1.box_code FROM strain_freezing_tube_stock_pre_entry t1 left join system_users t2 on t1.save_by = t2.id and t2.deleted= 0 left join strain_microbe_basic_info t3 on t3.id = t1.microbe_id and t3.deleted= 0 left join strain_freezing_tube_info t4 on t4.id = t1.tube_id and t4.deleted= 0 left join strain_freezing_tube_stock_info t5 on t5.stock_pre_entry_id = t1.id and t5.deleted = 0 where t1.deleted =0 and not exists ( select 1 from strain_outbound_sub_application a1 join strain_outbound_application a2 on a2.id = a1.parent_id and a2.appro_result='1' and a1.deleted = 0 and a2.deleted = 0 where a1.specimen_id = t1.id )
and t2.nickname like concat('%', #{req.saveByName}, '%')
and t3.chinese_name like concat('%', #{req.microbeName}, '%')
and t1.code like concat('%', #{req.code}, '%')
and t1.create_time >= #{req.createTime[0]} and t1.create_time <= #{req.createTime[1]}
and t1.status = #{req.status}
and t1.remark like concat('%', #{req.remark}, '%')
order by t1.box_code desc,t1.code,t5.tube_position_x,t5.tube_position_y

SELECT t2.nickname save_by_name, t3.chinese_name , t3.latin_name, t3.microbe_type, t3.source, t3.useage, t1.id, t1.code specimen_code, t1.expiration_date, t3.temperature, t1.save_date, t1.status, t1.create_time, t1.remark, t1.thaw_freeze_cycle_count, t5.id stock_id, t1.box_code FROM strain_freezing_tube_stock_pre_entry t1 left join system_users t2 on t1.save_by = t2.id and t2.deleted= 0 left join strain_microbe_basic_info t3 on t3.id = t1.microbe_id and t3.deleted= 0 left join strain_freezing_tube_stock_info t5 on t5.stock_pre_entry_id = t1.id and t5.deleted = 0 where t1.deleted =0 and t1.expiration_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) and t1.status = '1'
and t2.nickname like concat('%', #{req.saveByName}, '%')
and t3.chinese_name like concat('%', #{req.chineseName}, '%')
and t3.latin_name like concat('%', #{req.latinName}, '%')
and t3.microbe_type = #{req.microbeType}
and t1.code like concat('%', #{req.specimenCode}, '%')
order by t1.box_code desc,t1.code,t5.tube_position_x,t5.tube_position_y
